label: b1b2-fixtures-prior-tip
command:
"""B1/B2 regression fixtures as a standalone behavioural probe, using ONLY each tree's
own public API (build_reference_index, id_correctness, score_leg), so the same script
runs against the previous tip 6046f6b5 and the repaired tip. Exit 0 iff the repaired
behaviour holds. Data tables are read from the worktree C:/t/eval (unchanged by the lane)."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import t2pw.bench.eval_v2.reactions as R
from t2pw.bench.eval_v2.gold import load_supplement

print("reactions module:", R.__file__)
ref = R.build_reference_index(Path("C:/t/eval"))
sam = {"entities": {"compounds": [{"name": "S-adenosyl-L-methionine",
                                   "mapped_ids": {"kegg": "C00019", "pathbank_compound_id": "134"}}]}}
b1 = R.id_correctness(sam, ref)
b1_verdict = b1["counts"]
b1_ids = [w.get("contradicting_ids") for w in b1["wrong"]]
case = load_supplement()["PMC12657337"]
row = lambda outs: {"inputs": ["FPP"], "outputs": outs, "enzymes": [{"entity": "HepPPS"}]}  # noqa: E731
bad = R.score_leg(case, {"processes": {"reactions": [row(["heptanoyl pyrophosphate (HepPP)"])]}}, [], None)["rows"][0]
good = R.score_leg(case, {"processes": {"reactions": [row(["heptaprenyl diphosphate (HepPP)"])]}}, [], None)["rows"][0]
out = {"B1_sam_on_pathwhiz_134": {"counts": b1_verdict, "contradicting_ids": b1_ids},
       "B2_heptanoyl_hepp": {"class": bad["class"], "gold_ids": bad["gold_ids"]},
       "B2_control_heptaprenyl": {"class": good["class"], "gold_ids": good["gold_ids"]}}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
ok = (b1_verdict == {"wrong_identity": 1} and b1_ids == [["pathbank_compound_id:134"]]
      and bad["class"] != "target_paper_supported"
      and good["class"] == "target_paper_supported" and good["gold_ids"] == ["R1"])
print("REPAIRED BEHAVIOUR HOLDS" if ok else "REPAIRED BEHAVIOUR DOES NOT HOLD")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
